title: Box Office: ‘Mortal Kombat II’ Tops Friday but Continues to Battle ‘Prada 2’ for Mother’s Day Win
summary: New Line's martial arts sequel and 'The Devil Wears Prada 2' — which is passing up the first film's lifetime run of $326 million in only its second outing — are both on course to earn $40 million to $41 million at the weekend box office in North America.
